text:
Ashwin: Heads-up — during the UX release scheduled at 13:00 UTC we'll see a planned spike in inference allocations for tenant:product-demo. Can we temp-silence inference.alloc.p95 for ~45m? It's expected noise. @maria

ops-bot: Deployment scheduled: ux-release-7.2 at 2026-03-17T13:02:00Z — auto-notify

Maria: sounds reasonable. Please paste the alert id, dashboard link, and why 45m (vs 1h).

Ashwin: Alert id: inference.alloc.p95 (rule: p95 > 250ms over 5m, service=model-router). Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/inference-slo?orgId=1&refresh=5m Traces: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/trace/0abcd1234 We're expecting ~30m of heavy traffic, tails to ~45m.

Jonathan: I recommend 1h to be safe, but 45m OK if traffic pattern matches. To create a 1h snooze:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/ops/alerts/snooze \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
 -d '{"alert":"inference.alloc.p95","duration":"60m","reason":"ux release planned spike","owner":"ashwin"}'
```
I can run it if you want.

Ashwin: Can you run it jon? I'm coordinating the release.

Maria: Before muting, confirm no new 5xx in traces and gpu_utilization < 90%. Quick checks: `kibana -> logs-app-prod` or `kubectl logs -n inference model-router-*-pod`. For pods: `kubectl top pods -n inference | grep model-router`.

Jonathan: Running snooze now.

ops-bot: {"status":"ok","snooze_id":"snooze_2125558_1","expires_at":"2026-03-17T14:40:00Z","created_by":"jonathan"}

Ashwin: Thanks, monitoring dashboards. Will post in #incidents if anything abnormal. :thumbsup:

Maria: I'll watch p95 and 5xx for 20m. If anything slips we'll escalate and open a short follow-up note.

ops-bot: Snooze expires 2026-03-17T14:40:00Z (id: snooze_2125558_1).
